who_are_we_desc_2: ShinApp was created with one goal: to make finding, collaborating, and managing construction services fast, simple, and reliable.
who_are_we_desc_3: On our platform, you can find experienced specialists, crews, architects, designers, equipment rental services, and construction companies - all in one place.

trust_feature_1_desc: We create a secure environment where every specialist presents their experience, work, and ratings, allowing the client to make a confident decision.
trust_feature_2_desc: Specialists featured on the platform can have a verified profile, portfolio, and customer ratings, making it easier to make the right choice.
trust_feature_3_desc: Find the required specialist, crew, or equipment in seconds—by profession, location, rating, and availability.
who_are_we_desc_4: Whether you want to renovate an apartment, build a new home, or find specialists, ShinApp connects you with the right people.
about_subtitle: ShinApp: The new digital platform for the construction industry
about_desc_1: Construction and renovation are among the most important and responsible processes in life. Whether you're renovating an apartment, building a home, or designing a commercial space, successful outcomes always depend on choosing the right specialist.
about_desc_2: However, today this process is often complicated: people spend hours or even days finding reliable specialists, comparing offers, understanding pricing, and searching for various services. On the other hand, experienced professionals, crews, and small companies don't always have the opportunity to showcase themselves to new clients and grow their business.
about_desc_3: The ShinApp platform was created to solve exactly this problem.
about_desc_4: We want to build a single digital environment where all participants in the construction industry can easily find each other, collaborate, and execute successful projects.
about_goal_1: ShinApp's goal is to digitize the construction sector and make collaboration as simple, fast, and transparent as possible.
about_goal_2: We want anyone to be able to find the specialist they need in just a few minutes, view their experience, past work, and ratings, and get in touch immediately.
about_goal_3: At the same time, we aim to create an environment where specialists can present their skills, build a professional reputation, and get new orders—without intermediaries.
about_offers_desc_1: ShinApp is not just a directory of specialists. It's a multifunctional platform that brings the entire construction ecosystem together in one place. On the platform, you can:
about_offers_list_8: Filter by location, experience, and availability.
about_offers_desc_2: All this on one platform—fast and convenient.
about_values_1_desc: We believe that trust is the foundation of successful collaboration. That's why every specialist can showcase their portfolio, work experience, services, and customer ratings.
about_values_2_desc: Our aim is for clients to have as much information as possible to make the right decision before initiating contact.
about_values_3_desc: We encourage high professional quality and create an environment where the best specialists can receive the recognition they deserve for their work.
about_values_4_desc: We want everyone, regardless of their location or the size of their project, to easily find the services they need.
about_audience_desc: ShinApp is designed for anyone connected in any way to the construction and renovation industry.
about_audience_1_desc: If you want to renovate an apartment, build a house, or carry out any construction project, ShinApp lets you find trusted specialists and teams without long searches.
about_audience_2_desc: If you work as an electrician, plumber, painter, tiler, architect, designer, or other specialist, ShinApp gives you the opportunity to create a professional page, present your work, and get new orders.
about_audience_3_desc: Teams can have a single shared profile, present all their members, and take on larger projects.
about_audience_4_desc: Companies can present their services, post job listings, and expand their teams with new professionals.
about_audience_5_desc: Owners of construction machinery and equipment can showcase their inventory, set rental conditions, and easily find clients.
about_vision_1: We believe that the construction industry must also embrace modern digital solutions.
about_vision_2: Our vision is to build Armenia's largest and most reliable construction platform, uniting all industry participants into one community.
about_vision_3: In the future, ShinApp plans to introduce new features such as online bookings, smart search, automated estimates, digital contracts, a payment system, and many more industry-specific services.
about_mission_1: We believe that right collaborations begin with the right connections.
about_mission_2: ShinApp's mission is to create a platform where every client finds a reliable specialist, and every specialist finds new opportunities.
about_mission_3: We are building not just a technological platform, but a community where professional experience, honest work, and long-term partnerships are valued.

privacy_intro_1: ShinApp ("we", "us", or "our") operates a platform that connects clients with construction, repair, and equipment-rental specialists and companies. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacy_intro_2: By creating an account or otherwise using ShinApp, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy.
privacy_collect_intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, information generated as you use the platform, and information collected automatically.
privacy_collect_account_desc: When you register, we collect your name, email address, phone number, password, and the role you sign up as (client, master, or company).
privacy_collect_profile_desc: Depending on your role, this may include your avatar, business details such as your tax identification number (ITN), region and city, working areas, portfolio images, and any social media links you choose to add.
privacy_collect_content_desc: This includes announcements, orders, reviews, messages you exchange with other users, and any images you upload.
privacy_collect_technical_desc: We automatically record technical data such as your IP address, browser and device type, and pages you visit. For example, we use this data to count views on announcements once per visitor per day, and to detect and prevent fraudulent or automated activity.
privacy_collect_cookies_desc: We use cookies and local storage to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, and understand how the platform is used.
privacy_use_1: To create and manage your account and provide access to the platform.
privacy_use_2: To connect clients with masters and companies, and to enable orders, messaging, and reviews.
privacy_use_3: To send you notifications about orders, messages, and announcements relevant to you.
privacy_use_4: To respond to your questions and support requests.
privacy_use_5: To detect, prevent, and investigate fraud, abuse, and security incidents, including inflated or fake view counts.
privacy_use_6: To improve the platform, develop new features, and comply with our legal obligations.
privacy_sharing_intro: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in the following situations:
privacy_sharing_1: With other users, when information is part of your public profile, an announcement, or a conversation you take part in.
privacy_sharing_2: With service providers who help us operate the platform, such as hosting, file storage, and email delivery providers, under obligations to protect your data.
privacy_sharing_3: With Google, if you choose to sign in or register using your Google account.
privacy_sharing_4: When required by law, or to protect the rights, safety, and property of ShinApp, our users, or the public.
privacy_retention_desc: We keep your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the platform, resolve disputes, and comply with our legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account at any time.
privacy_security_desc: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including password hashing and access controls. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy_rights_intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:
privacy_rights_1: Access the personal information we hold about you.
privacy_rights_3: Request deletion of your account and associated data.
privacy_rights_4: Object to or restrict certain uses of your information.
privacy_rights_contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacy_children_desc: ShinApp is not directed at individuals under the age of 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can remove it.
privacy_changes_desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the updated policy on this page with a new "last updated" date.
privacy_contact_desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us:
